candidates.name: Pea-Green Textured Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The subtle texture and controlled shoulder are useful, but the actual color reads muted khaki rather than pea green. Its long open overshirt body, large flap pocket and visible white T-shirt make it Casual or Travel rather than a self-contained Summer Office top.

candidates.name: Pink Button-Up Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The pink is cheerful, but the distressed plaid, raw frayed edges, very long open body, dropped shoulder and oversized patch pocket create grunge Festival or Casual styling rather than modern Office polish.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Long-Sleeve Button-Down
candidates.decisionReason: The sky blue is fresh, but the hanger composition supplies no worn fit proof and shows the shirt only as an open layer over a white T-shirt. Preserve it for Summer Casual, Travel or Resort.

candidates.name: Khaki Mock-Neck Short-Sleeve Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only image gives no reliable shoulder, torso or hem proof, while the narrow ribbed sleeve openings and long tapered body risk a fitted dated knit. The muted khaki also fails the requested happier Summer palette.

candidates.name: White Mock-Neck Short-Sleeve Top
candidates.decisionReason: Only a flat product image is available, so fit and drape are unproven. The plain T-shirt body and synthetic-looking mock collar do not establish a refined Office knit or purposeful color story.

candidates.name: White Short-Sleeve Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The lightweight white shirt can serve Resort or Casual, but the hanger-only open-over-tee image cannot prove fit, and the soft band collar plus curved hem read informal rather than Office-ready.

candidates.name: Light-Green Casual Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only image supplies no worn fit proof, while two large asymmetric utility pockets, dark buttons, a black wordmark patch and long sleeves make the shirt technical and visually cluttered for Summer Office.

candidates.name: Pastel-Blue Clean Chino Short
candidates.decisionReason: The pastel blue is welcome, but only a product image is available. The shiny surface, elastic side waistband, rolled hem and conventional narrow shape read inexpensive casual chino short rather than tailored Office Bermuda.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Cotton-Linen Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The color is fresh, but the gathered elastic waist, visible drawstring, crinkled fabric and barefoot source read lounge or Resort. The image does not prove a clean shoe break or tailored Summer Office construction.

candidates.name: Gray Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: Although the leg is controlled, the fully gathered waist, oversized exposed drawcord, black D-ring and synthetic sheen turn it into a casual technical trouser. The cropped source also hides the shoe break.

candidates.name: Navy Lightweight Relaxed-Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The dark navy conflicts with the lighter Summer direction, while the broad leg pools over the sneakers and the small zip detail reads technical. It would repeat the baggy-bottom problem.

candidates.name: Camel Relaxed-Straight Cotton Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The camel color and easy cotton can serve Spring or Fall Casual, but the leg is long enough to stack at the chunky sneaker and the sweatshirt styling confirms a casual rather than airy Summer Office direction.

candidates.name: Khaki Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The light khaki texture may work for Resort, but the wrinkled product-only image gives no rise, thigh or hem proof and the long rolled knee-short proportion is too casual for this Office core.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Toile Knee-Length Short
candidates.decisionReason: The blue botanical toile is cheerful and the straight knee-length shape is controlled, but the all-over print and casual sneaker styling belong to Resort, Vacation or a daytime Party rather than Office.

candidates.name: Sage Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The sage is attractive, but the product-only image lacks worn fit proof and the integrated webbing belt, exposed zip pockets and diagonal technical seams make it an outdoor short rather than tailored Office Bermuda.
